data.narrative:
Anyon Systems is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Alireza Najafi-Yazdi, having raised C$23M+ to date. The quantum computing sector includes 3 public comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers, with notable privates including Quantinuum, IonQ (prior to public listing), D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Peer-Median triangulation proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing universe—no narrow peer set met the three-datapoint threshold. Stage-Progression analysis was therefore the primary applicable method. Using total raised ($23M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $46M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $39M to $53M, with a median of $46M. This range reflects the single-method limitation inherent in the available data. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-stage comparable transactions in quantum computing, which limits calibration of the stage-progression multiplier, and the absence of disclosed metrics (burn rate, technical milestones, IP position) that would strengthen the valuation thesis. The quantum sector's early-stage heterogeneity—with peers spanning different quantum modalities and commercialization timelines—further constrains peer-based validation.
